versions.changelog:
jf-smart-store-inspection v1.0.0

- Initial release of the smart store AI inspection skill for JFTech HoneyCloud.
- Supports full workflow for store creation, device onboarding (GB28181/ONVIF/NVR/IPC), AI patrol plan management, and inspection record aggregation.
- Allows querying of authorized AI algorithms, configuring patrol plans (evacuation, uniform, helmet, fall detection, customer flow, video quality, etc.), and drawing detection areas via snapshot-based polygon tools.
- Generates interactive HTML analysis reports with captured images, device/algorithm stats, and exportable results.
- CLI workflow guides included for zero-to-production deployment, plan/record management, and visual area configuration.
- Environment setup, authentication, and all major API endpoints documented for ease of use.
